1.title: The Birth of John the Baptist Foretold
1.outline: I. Prologue, II. Gabriel appears to Zechariah, III. Gabriel appears to Mary, IV. Mary visits Elizabeth, V. Birth of John
1.summary: Luke establishes the historical accuracy of his account. Angels announce the births of John the Baptist and Jesus. Mary rejoices and John is born, followed by Zechariah's prophetic song.

2.title: The Birth and Childhood of Jesus
2.outline: I. Jesus' birth in Bethlehem, II. Angels and shepherds, III. Presentation in the temple, IV. The boy Jesus at the temple
2.summary: Jesus is born in a manger in Bethlehem. Angels announce his birth to shepherds. Jesus is presented at the temple to Simeon and Anna, and later amazes teachers at the temple at age twelve.

3.title: John the Baptist Prepares the Way
3.outline: I. Ministry of John the Baptist, II. Baptism of Jesus, III. Genealogy of Jesus
3.summary: John preaches repentance and baptizes Jesus. God affirms Jesus as His Son. The genealogy traces Jesus' lineage back to Adam, emphasizing his role as Savior of all humanity.

4.title: The Temptation and Early Ministry
4.outline: I. Temptation in the wilderness, II. Rejection at Nazareth, III. Healing in Capernaum
4.summary: Jesus resists Satan's temptations in the desert. He declares the fulfillment of Isaiah's prophecy in Nazareth but is rejected. He then heals many and drives out demons in Capernaum.

5.title: The First Disciples and Early Healings
5.outline: I. Miraculous catch of fish, II. Healing a leper and paralytic, III. Calling of Levi
5.summary: Jesus calls Peter, James, and John after a miraculous catch of fish. He heals a leper and a paralyzed man, demonstrating authority to forgive sins. He calls Levi, a tax collector, and eats with sinners.

6.title: Lord of the Sabbath and the Sermon on the Plain
6.outline: I. Lord of the Sabbath, II. The Twelve Apostles, III. Blessings and woes, IV. Love for enemies
6.summary: Jesus clashes with Pharisees over the Sabbath. He chooses twelve apostles. He delivers the Sermon on the Plain, teaching about blessings, woes, loving enemies, and judging others.

7.title: Faith and Forgiveness
7.outline: I. Healing the centurion's servant, II. Raising the widow's son, III. Jesus and John the Baptist, IV. A sinful woman forgiven
7.summary: Jesus heals a Roman centurion's servant by word alone and raises a widow's son from the dead. He praises John the Baptist and forgives a sinful woman who washes his feet, teaching about love and forgiveness.

8.title: Parables and Miracles
8.themes: Word of God, power over nature and demons, faith
8.outline: I. Women accompanying Jesus, II. Parable of the Sower, III. Calming the storm, IV. Healing the demon-possessed and the sick
8.summary: Jesus travels with his disciples and women who support him. He teaches the Parable of the Sower. He calms a storm, casts out the Legion of demons, heals a bleeding woman, and raises Jairus's daughter.

9.title: Sending the Twelve and the Transfiguration
9.outline: I. Sending the Twelve, II. Feeding the 5,000, III. Peter's confession and the Transfiguration, IV. Cost of following Jesus
9.summary: Jesus sends out the Twelve, feeds five thousand, and is transfigured on a mountain. He predicts his death and teaches about the cost of discipleship as he sets out for Jerusalem.

10.title: The Mission of the Seventy-Two and the Good Samaritan
10.outline: I. Sending the Seventy-Two, II. Parable of the Good Samaritan, III. Martha and Mary
10.summary: Jesus sends seventy-two disciples on a mission. He teaches the Parable of the Good Samaritan to define who a neighbor is, and visits Martha and Mary, emphasizing listening to his word.

11.title: Prayer and Confrontation
11.outline: I. The Lord's Prayer, II. Jesus and Beelzebul, III. Woes to the Pharisees
11.summary: Jesus teaches the disciples to pray. He defends his power to cast out demons against accusations. He delivers strong woes against the Pharisees and experts in the law for their hypocrisy.

12.title: Warnings and Encouragements
12.outline: I. Warnings against hypocrisy and fear, II. Parable of the Rich Fool, III. Do not worry, IV. Watchfulness
12.summary: Jesus warns against hypocrisy and greed, using the Parable of the Rich Fool. He tells his disciples not to worry, to seek God's kingdom, and to be ready for the Son of Man's return.

13.title: Repentance and the Kingdom
13.themes: Repentance, healing on the Sabbath, kingdom growth
13.outline: I. Call to repentance, II. Healing a crippled woman, III. Parables of the Mustard Seed and Yeast, IV. The Narrow Door
13.summary: Jesus urges repentance, using the tragedy of the Galileans and the tower of Siloam. He heals a crippled woman on the Sabbath. He teaches parables about the kingdom's growth and the narrow door.

14.title: The Great Banquet and the Cost of Discipleship
14.outline: I. Healing on the Sabbath, II. Humility and hospitality, III. Parable of the Great Banquet, IV. Cost of discipleship
14.summary: Jesus heals a man on the Sabbath and teaches about humility. He tells the Parable of the Great Banquet, showing that the kingdom includes the outcast, and explains the high cost of being his disciple.

15.title: The Lost and Found Parables
15.outline: I. The Lost Sheep, II. The Lost Coin, III. The Lost Son
15.summary: In response to Pharisees grumbling about him eating with sinners, Jesus tells three parables—the Lost Sheep, the Lost Coin, and the Prodigal Son—highlighting heaven's joy when a sinner repents.

16.title: Wealth and the Afterlife
16.outline: I. Parable of the Shrewd Manager, II. Teachings on the Law, III. The Rich Man and Lazarus
16.summary: Jesus tells the Parable of the Shrewd Manager to teach about the proper use of wealth. He tells the story of the Rich Man and Lazarus, illustrating the eternal consequences of ignoring the poor.

17.title: Forgiveness, Faith, and the Kingdom
17.outline: I. Sin, faith, and duty, II. Ten healed of leprosy, III. The coming of the Kingdom
17.summary: Jesus teaches about causing others to stumble, forgiveness, and faith. He heals ten lepers, but only one returns to give thanks. He describes the sudden and unmistakable nature of his return.

18.title: Prayer, Humility, and the Journey to Jerusalem
18.outline: I. Parable of the Persistent Widow, II. Pharisee and Tax Collector, III. The Rich Young Ruler, IV. Healing a blind beggar
18.summary: Jesus teaches persistence in prayer and humility before God. He interacts with little children and a rich ruler, illustrating the difficulty of wealth for salvation, and heals a blind man near Jericho.

19.title: Zacchaeus and the Triumphal Entry
19.outline: I. Zacchaeus the tax collector, II. Parable of the Ten Minas, III. The Triumphal Entry, IV. Cleansing the temple
19.summary: Jesus brings salvation to the household of Zacchaeus. He teaches the Parable of the Ten Minas about stewardship. He rides into Jerusalem to a welcoming crowd, weeps over the city, and cleanses the temple.

20.title: Conflicts in the Temple
20.outline: I. Jesus' authority questioned, II. Parable of the Tenants, III. Paying taxes to Caesar, IV. Marriage at the resurrection
20.summary: Jesus' authority is challenged by the religious leaders. He tells the Parable of the Tenants against them. He answers tricky questions about paying taxes to Caesar and the reality of the resurrection.

21.title: The Widow's Offering and the End of the Age
21.outline: I. The Widow's Offering, II. Destruction of the temple foretold, III. Signs of the end of the age
21.summary: Jesus commends a poor widow's offering. He predicts the destruction of the temple and describes the signs of the end of the age, urging his followers to be watchful and endure.

22.title: The Last Supper and Betrayal
22.outline: I. Judas's agreement, II. The Last Supper, III. Prayer on the Mount of Olives, IV. Arrest and Peter's denial
22.summary: Jesus celebrates the Last Supper, establishing the New Covenant. He prays in agony on the Mount of Olives. He is betrayed by Judas, arrested, and Peter denies him three times.

23.title: The Trial and Crucifixion
23.outline: I. Jesus before Pilate and Herod, II. The Crucifixion, III. The two criminals, IV. Jesus' death and burial
23.summary: Jesus is tried before Pilate and Herod, who find no fault in him, but he is sentenced to death. He is crucified with two criminals, offering salvation to one. He dies and is buried by Joseph of Arimathea.

24.title: The Resurrection and Ascension
24.outline: I. The empty tomb, II. The road to Emmaus, III. Jesus appears to the disciples, IV. The Ascension
24.summary: Women find the tomb empty and are told Jesus has risen. He appears to two disciples on the road to Emmaus, explaining the Scriptures, and then to the eleven. He blesses them and ascends into heaven.
